title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-16
lineage: MAC (modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M on Maxell metal tape, about 20 feet in front of the soundboard) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording of a solid 80s Warfield show, but the tape’s clarity is uneven.
ai_review.review: The performance captures an upbeat early‑80s Dead set that many fans find enjoyable, though the mix leans heavily on crowd ambience and can be hard to hear at times. Reviewers note a crisp live feel despite some Dolby processing and analogue hiss, while others criticize the muddier sections and an overabundance of cowboy‑style material.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews provide a clear spread (2–4 stars) with consistent comments about decent but imperfect sound and an average musical experience, allowing a confident mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is described as decent but not great; some listeners note Dolby processing and slight analogue hiss, while others find the band hard to hear due to crowd noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised as a solid 80s Warfield show but noted for being heavy on cowboy‑style songs, leading to mixed feelings about the overall flow.
